remarks: Welcome to the Archer Model by Coventry Homes! This stunning home features a SEPARATE ENTRANCE & 9' CEILINGS ON THE MAIN FLOOR & BASEMENT! The gorgeous kitchen offers quartz counters, stainless steel appliances & walk-through pantry, flowing into the dining area & inviting living room with a beautiful fireplace. A main floor den & 2pc bath add flexibility. Upstairs, the primary suite is a relaxing retreat with a walk-in closet & luxurious 5pc ensuite featuring dual sinks, freestanding soaker tub & stand-up shower. Two additional bedrooms, full bath, bonus room & upstairs laundry complete the upper level. The FULLY FINISHED BASEMENT offers a family room, 4th bedroom & full bath. Built with quality craftsmanship & backed by the Alberta New Home Warranty Program for peace of mind. *Home is under construction, photos are not of actual home, some finishings may vary, some photos virtually staged.* (id:67522)
